name: SEO Keyword Research
description: A reviewed opportunity map choosing refresh, link, create, overlap investigation, deferral or rejection with existing-page evidence and a clear validation handoff.
audience: SEO and content teams choosing which existing pages to improve and which content gaps to fill
problem: Keyword research produces broad high-volume lists when it is not anchored to the business, audience, product proximity, and existing authority.
outcome: A reviewed opportunity map choosing refresh, link, create, overlap investigation, deferral or rejection with existing-page evidence and a clear validation handoff.
whyAi: AI can connect keyword data, SERP patterns, competitor evidence, and project context while the operator owns positioning and priority.
operatorPath: Example request: “Use SEO Keyword Research for our time-tracking app. We sell to small UK agencies. Review our current pages and Search Console export. Recommend pages to improve or add, and topics to leave alone. Stop with the plan.”
Supply the website URL, audience and market. Name what the product does, topics to avoid, and the sources the agent may use.
Review the recommended action for each topic and its supporting evidence. Check whether an existing page already answers the question before assigning new content.
agentPath: Read business goals and an existing-content inventory, including pages absent from Search Console.
Collect the smallest useful approved research, first-party or export evidence set.
Map intent and business fit to existing pages, independently review dispositions, and store one canonical opportunity map.
recovery: If a provider is unavailable, use approved exports or stop with the exact missing dataset.
Do not fill the report with broad terms that fail the product-proximity or authority test.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop after the prioritized opportunity map; article production is a separate approved job.

handoffs.when: A selected opportunity should become an evidence-backed branded article.
Reviewed opportunities call for a bounded existing-page or internal-link improvement.

prerequisites: Your website, business goal, intended readers and target market
What the business can credibly help with, plus topics or competitors to exclude
Access to current pages and approved evidence, such as a Search Console export, keyword research or competitor pages; available connected tools can supply that evidence
proof: A map from reader questions to existing pages or genuine gaps, with sources, recommended actions, confidence and the next check.
Illustrative refresh entry: the pricing page covers billing rules, but readers have to search the FAQ to find them. Bring those rules beside the price and keep the existing URL.
Illustrative new-page entry: no checked page explains timesheet approval, and the product documentation can support a worked guide. Propose that guide and name the evidence the writer should use.
Illustrative defer entry: “best accounting software” asks about a different purchase from the time-tracking app. Leave it outside this plan.
One saved, reviewed opportunity map, including decisions to leave content alone. Writing and publication are separate jobs.
whenToUse: A project needs SEO opportunities from seed terms, competitors, or an agent-defined research angle.

stages.title: Orient And Map Existing Work
stages.summary: Define reader tasks, business fit, markets and current page coverage before selecting opportunities.

stages.title: Collect Relevant Evidence
stages.summary: Gather bounded first-party, public, research or supplied-export evidence.

stages.title: Review Intent And Page Dispositions
stages.summary: Make one reviewed choice for each opportunity, including deliberate no-change choices.

stages.title: Store Reviewed Opportunities
stages.summary: Persist the canonical opportunity map with future-readable evidence and handoffs.

stages.title: Capture Supported Learning
stages.summary: Keep reusable evidence-supported lessons separate from speculative heuristics.
